$comment: Acceptance profiles for visual_diff.py --criteria. Copy and tune per screen; never loosen a profile to make a failing run pass — record the failure and its cause instead. Pick the profile that matches how controlled the environment is.

controlled.$use_when: Same renderer, fonts, assets, DPR, viewport, insets and app state as the reference (e.g. golden vs golden, or our own build vs our own approved capture).

cross_environment.$use_when: Reference from a different app/device (third-party screenshot): different fonts, photos, text anti-aliasing. Numbers are evidence only; combine with geometry checks and manual review.

geometry.$comment: Measured with measure.py on both images, in logical px. Tolerances are per element type.

always_required: identical viewport (logical) and DPR between reference and output, or a recorded resample with reason
no overflow / clipped elements (flutter test overflow checks + visual)
no navigation or functional regressions (existing test suite green)
MAE and SSIM reported for every comparison
every significant discrepancy fixed or documented with its cause
